events.title: 2026/10/11 Patch Note
events.summary: Hello everyone! The demo has been updated!This update focuses on bringing more variety to the game.ContentNew mechanics have been added!Paper sizes now range from 4 × 4 to 10 × 10, instead of being fixed at 8 × 8.Gray areas that can’t be colored now come in various layouts, instead of being restricted to the second and fourth quadrants.Introducing the eraser! You can now erase both fixed tiles and tiles you’ve colored.The number of stages has increased from 25 to 35.New skins have been added! Di

events.title: 2026/08/22 Patch Note
events.summary: Hello everyone — the demo has been updated!This update focuses primarily on usability improvements.CONTENTSReworked Hint system.Hint types consolidated from 3 into 1.Hint cost increased from 1 'stamp' to 2.UIReworked the FOLD buttons.Left button → horizontal foldTop button → vertical foldOLDNEWAND MORETutorials (except for control key guides) no longer rely on guide images. They now require you to actually perform the action to progress.Partially revised the epilogue illustrations.
